decisions.reason: Margin analysis builds on the firm's core market-data offer, has its own page as a visible commitment, and fits the announced platform expansion, so management sees early weak results as temporary.
Gas tariff comparison is close to the established business, relies on databases the firm already maintains, and has a dedicated page, so sunk investment and visibility favor keeping it.
The electricity tariff calculator is central to the firm's tariff-calculation identity and is publicly presented, so dropping it would contradict earlier decisions.
Only mentioned on the website, so public commitment is lower, but it overlaps the core calculator offer and fits the platform strategy, so management persists.
The area definition tool supports the location-based products and the central platform, and its own page signals commitment that management will want to justify.
Site-specific comparison has less visibility, but it sits close to the established offer and costs little to maintain, so it is retained as part of the integrated platform.
